34800.meaning1: with Dhamma palace as the foremost (among them)

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītipāsādasahassāni ahesuṃ dhammapāsādappamukhāni.

34801.meaning1: who drinks the Dhamma; who delights in the Dhamma

examples.text: dhammapīti sukhaṃ seti, vippasannena cetasā, ariyappavedite dhamme, sadā ramati paṇḍito.

34802.meaning1: flavour of delight in the Dhamma; juice of joy in the teaching

examples.text: pavivekarasaṃ pitvā, rasaṃ upasamassa ca, niddaro hoti nippāpo, dhammapītirasaṃ pivaṃ.

34804.meaning1: giving precedence to the teaching; explaining the nature of things; aiming at the Dhamma
34804.commentary: (VINa) dhammapurekkhārassā'ti pāḷiṃ vācentassa vā sajjhāyantassa vā. evaṃ atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca purakkhatvā bhaṇantassa atthapurekkhārassa ca dhammapurekkhārassa ca anāpatti.

examples.text: anāpatti atthapurekkhārassa, dhammapurekkhārassa, anusāsanipurekkhārassa, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
imā kho bhikkhave, dve pūjā. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ pūjānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammapūjā'ti.

34806.meaning1: illuminating the Dhamma; explaining the teaching
34806.commentary: (DNa) etādisī dhammappakāsan'etthā'ti ettha sāsane evarūpā dhammappakāsanā, yāya sāvakā etehi guṇehi samannāgatā honti.

examples.text: etādisī dhammappakāsan'ettha, na tattha kiṃkaṅkhati koci sāvako, nitiṇṇa-oghaṃ vicikicchachinnaṃ, buddhaṃ namassāma jinaṃ jan'indaṃ.

34807.meaning1: having the teaching as a refuge; with the Dhamma as one's support
34807.commentary: (MNa) dhammappaṭisaraṇā'ti dhammo amhākaṃ paṭisaraṇaṃ, dhammo avassayo'ti dīpeti.

examples.text: evaṃ appaṭisaraṇe ca pana, bho ānanda, ko hetu sāmaggiyā'ti? na kho mayaṃ, brāhmaṇa, appaṭisaraṇā, sappaṭisaraṇā mayaṃ, brāhmaṇa, dhammappaṭisaraṇā'ti.

34808.meaning1: connected with the Dhamma; regarding the teaching

examples.text: ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma nāmaṃ, buddhappaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, dhammappaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, saṅghappaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu anoññātaṃ anavaññātaṃ ahīḷitaṃ aparibhūtaṃ cittīkataṃ, etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma nāmaṃ.

34809.meaning1: experiencing mental phenomena; conscious of thought
34809.meaning2: experiencing mental phenomena; conscious of thought

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, upavāṇa, bhikkhu manasā dhammaṃ viññāya dhammappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammarāgappaṭisaṃvedī ca.

34810.meaning1: who measures by teaching; appraising by Dhamma; who judges on the basis of instruction
34810.commentary: (ANa) dhamme pamāṇaṃ gahetvā pasanno dhammappamāṇo nāma… satasahassaṃ koṭṭhāse katvā pana eko koṭṭhāso'va dhammappamāṇo, sesā na dhammappamāṇā'ti veditabbā.

examples.text: rūpappamāṇo rūpappasanno, ghosappamāṇo ghosappasanno, lūkhappamāṇo lūkhappasanno, dhammappamāṇo dhammappasanno. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.

34811.meaning1: delighted by the Dhamma; pleased by the teaching; (comm) cause for happiness
34811.commentary: (ANa) dhammappamoditānaṃ satan'ti ettha dhammo vuccati kāraṇaṃ, kenaci'd'eva kāraṇena pamuditānaṃ santānaṃ.

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, setughāto gīte, setughāto nacce, alaṃ vo dhammappamoditānaṃ sataṃ sitaṃ sitamattāyā'ti.

34812.meaning1: who has confidence in teaching; whose faith is based on Dhamma; pleased by instruction

examples.text: rūpappamāṇo rūpappasanno, ghosappamāṇo ghosappasanno, lūkhappamāṇo lūkhappasanno, dhammappamāṇo dhammappasanno. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.

34813.meaning1: treasurer of the Dhamma; epithet of Ānanda
34813.commentary: (DNt) tathā dhammabhaṇḍ'āgāro, tattha niyutto'ti dhammabhaṇḍ'āgāriko. atha vā nānārājabhaṇḍarakkhako bhaṇḍ'āgāriko viyā'ti bhaṇḍ'āgāriko, dhammassa anurakkhako bhaṇḍ'āgārikoti tam'eva sadisatākāraṇadassanena visesetvā dhammabhaṇḍ'āgāriko'ti vutto. (APt) dhammo pariyatti, so'va bhaṇḍaṃ dhanaṃ sukhadāyakato, tassa agāraṃ ṭhapan'aṭṭhānaṃ gehaṃ, tabbhāve tiṭṭhatī'ti dhammabhaṇḍ'āgāriko, iko.

34815.commentary: (MNa) aviparītasabhāv'aṭṭhena pariyattidhammappavattanato vā hadayena cintetvā vācāya nicchāritadhammamayo'ti dhammabhūto.

examples.text: so h'āvuso, bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati, cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto, vattā pavattā, atthassa ninnetā, amatassa dātā, dhammassāmī tathāgato

34817.meaning1: value of the teaching; richness of the Dhamma; wealth of the teaching
34817.commentary: (SNa) dhamm'ojaṃ dhammabhogan'ti ubhayen'api dhammaparibhogo'va kathito. (ANa) catunnaṃ paccayānaṃ bhuñjanaṃ āmisabhogo, dhammassa bhuñjanaṃ dhammabhogo.

examples.text: taṃ mayaṃ āyasmato sāriputtassa dhamm'ojaṃ dhammabhogaṃ dhamm'ānuggahaṃ anussarāmā'ti.

34818.meaning1: explained the teaching (to); clarified the Dhamma (for)
34818.meaning2: explained the teaching; clarified the Dhamma

examples.text: iti buddho abhiññāya, dhammam'akkhāsi bhikkhunaṃ, dukkhass'antakaro satthā, cakkhumā parinibbuto'ti.

34819.meaning1: stinginess about the Dhamma; selfishness with the teaching
34819.commentary: (DNa) dhammamacchariyaṃ. tena samannāgato bhikkhu imaṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā eso maṃ abhibhavissatī'ti aññassa na deti. yo pana dhamm'ānuggahena vā puggal'ānuggahena vā na deti, na taṃ macchariyaṃ.

examples.text: pañca macchariyāni, āvāsamacchariyaṃ, kulamacchariyaṃ, lābhamacchariyaṃ, vaṇṇamacchariyaṃ, dhammamacchariyaṃ.

34820.meaning1: stingy with (sharing) the teaching; selfish about (teaching) Dhamma
34820.commentary: (ANa) dhammamaccharinī'ti pariyattidhammaṃ maccharāyati, aññesaṃ dātuṃ na icchati.

examples.text: katamehi pañcahi? āvāsamaccharinī hoti, kulamaccharinī hoti, lābhamaccharinī hoti, vaṇṇamaccharinī hoti, dhammamaccharinī hoti. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgatā bhikkhunī yath'ābhataṃ nikkhittā evaṃ niraye.

34821.grammar: ger of dhammaṃ ājānāti, comp vb
34821.meaning1: understanding the Dhamma; comprehending the teaching

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu, sutānañ'ca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti, dhātānañ'ca dhammānaṃ atth'ūpaparikkhī hoti attham'aññāya dhammam'aññāya, dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno hoti.
kusalī bhāsasī tesaṃ, mārapāsappahāyinaṃ, kassa te dhammam'aññāya, acchiduṃ bhavabandhanan'ti.

34822.meaning1: taught the Dhamma; preached the Dhamma
34822.commentary: (NIDD2) dhammam'adesesī'ti dhamman'ti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ… nibbānañ'ca nibbānagāminiñ'ca paṭipadaṃ ācikkhi desesi paññapesi paṭṭhapesi vivari vibhaji uttānīakāsi pakāsesī'ti, yo te dhammam'adesesi.

examples.text: buddho dhammam'adesesi, jātiyā samatikkamaṃ, sabbadukkhappahānāya, so maṃ sacce nivesayi.

34823.meaning1: teaches the Dhamma; explains the teaching
34823.commentary: (SNa) yo dhammam'anusāsatī'ti yo dhammaṃ anusāsati, aṭṭhakathaṃ katheti, pāḷiṃ vāceti, pucchitapañhaṃ vissajjeti, kammaṭṭhānaṃ ācikkhati, dhammassavanaṃ karoti, sabbo'p'esa dhammaṃ anusāsati nāma.

examples.text: so ca sabbadado hoti, yo dadāti upassayaṃ, amataṃ dado ca so hoti, yo dhammam'anusāsatī'ti.

34824.meaning1: made of the Dhamma; (comm) made of wisdom

examples.text: sele yathā pabbatamuddhaniṭṭhito, yathā'pi passe janataṃ samantato, tath'ūpamaṃ dhammamayaṃ sumedho, pāsādam'āruyha samantacakkhu, sok'āvatiṇṇaṃ janatam'apetasoko, avekkhati jātijar'ābhibhūtan'ti.

34825.meaning1: made of mental phenomena; consisting of thought

examples.text: yo taṃ dhammamayaṃ vegaṃ sahati, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atari manosamuddaṃ saūmiṃ sāvaṭṭaṃ sagāhaṃ sarakkhasaṃ, tiṇṇo pāraṅ'gato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo'ti.

34827.meaning1: concerning the teaching; about the Dhamma

examples.text: satthāraṃ dhammam'ārabbha, saṅghaṃ sīlāni attano, adhigacchasi pāmojjaṃ, pītisukhamasaṃsayaṃ, tato pāmojjabahulo, dukkhass'antaṃ karissasī'ti.

34828.meaning1: supreme teaching; highest Dhamma; ultimate reality; ultimate nature of things

examples.text: yo ca vassasataṃ jīve, apassaṃ dhammam'uttamaṃ, ek'āhaṃ jīvitaṃ seyyo, passato dhammam'uttamaṃ.
tañ'c'āhaṃ abhinandāmi, mahesi dhammam'uttamaṃ, yaṃ viditvā sato caraṃ, tare loke visattikaṃ.

34829.meaning1: only the Dhamma; just the teaching

examples.text: anuyogo ca kho, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho, micchāpaṭipadā'ti, iti vadaṃ dhammam'eva deseti.
yo dhammayāgaṃ ayajī amaccharī, tathāgato sabbabhūt'ānukampī, taṃ tādisaṃ devamanussaseṭṭhaṃ, sattā namassanti bhavassa pāragun'ti.

yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno atth'ūpasaṃhitaṃ dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā ahosi, bahujanaṃ nidaṃsesi, pāṇīnaṃ hitasukh'āvaho dhammayāgī.

34832.meaning1: vehicle of Dhamma; carriage of reality
34832.commentary: (SNa) ayañ'hi sabbadosavigamena seṭṭho, iminā ca ariyā nibbānaṃ yantī'ti brahmayānaṃ iti'pi, dhammabhūtattā yānattā ca dhammayānaṃ iti'pi, anuttarattā kilesasaṅgāmassa ca vijitattā anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo iti'pi vattuṃ vaṭṭati.

examples.text: sakkā, ānandā'ti bhagavā avoca, imass'eva kho etaṃ, ānanda, ariyassa aṭṭh'aṅgikassa maggassa adhivacanaṃ, brahmayānaṃ iti'pi, dhammayānaṃ iti'pi, anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo iti'pī'ti.
cirassaṃ vata me mahito mah'esī, mahāvanaṃ samaṇo paccapādi, so'haṃ cajissāmi sahassapāpaṃ, sutvāna gāthaṃ tava dhammayuttaṃ.

34834.meaning1: devoted to (learning and preaching) the teaching
34834.commentary: (ANa) dhamme yogo anuyogo etesan'ti dhammayogā. dhammakathikānaṃ etaṃ nāmaṃ.

examples.text: idh'āvuso, dhammayogā bhikkhū jhāyī bhikkhū apasādenti, ime pana jhāyino'mhā, jhāyino'mhā'ti jhāyanti pajjhāyanti nijjhāyanti avajjhāyanti

34835.commentary: (VIN) dhammarakkhitā nāma sahadhammikā rakkhanti gopenti issariyaṃ kārenti vasaṃ vattenti.

examples.text: yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi

34836.meaning1: generic monk's name used in vinaya examples

34837.meaning1: lover of the teaching; devoted to the Dhamma

examples.text: dhamm'ārāmo dhammarato, dhammaṃ anuvicintayaṃ, dhammaṃ anussaraṃ bhikkhu, saddhammā na parihāyati.

34838.meaning1: taking pleasure in mental phenomena; pleased by thinking

examples.text: mano kho, māgaṇḍiya, dhamm'ārāmo dhammarato dhammasammudito. so tathāgatassa danto gutto rakkhito saṃvuto, tassa ca saṃvarāya dhammaṃ deseti.

34839.meaning1: treasure of the teaching; jewel of the Dhamma

examples.text: imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve ratanāni. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ dvinnaṃ ratanānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammaratanan'ti.

34840.meaning1: delight in the Dhamma; love for the Dhamma
34840.commentary: (DHPa) yāpesā puttarati-dhīturati-dhanarati-itthirati-naccagītavādit'ādirati-pabhedā ca anekappabhedā ratī, sā'pi saṃsāravaṭṭe pātetvā dukkh'ānubhavanass'eva paccayo. yā pan'esā dhammaṃ kathentassa vā suṇantassa vā vācentassa vā anto uppajjamānā pīti udaggabhāvaṃ janeti, assūni pavatteti, lomahaṃsaṃ janeti, sāyaṃ saṃsāravaṭṭassa antaṃ katvā arahattapariyosānā hoti. tasmā sabbaratīnaṃ evarūpā dhammarati'y'eva seṭṭhā. tena vuttaṃ, sabbaratiṃ dhammarati jinātī'ti

examples.text: sabbadānaṃ dhammadānaṃ jināti, sabbarasaṃ dhammaraso jināti, sabbaratiṃ dhammarati jināti, taṇhakkhayo sabbadukkhaṃ jināti.

34841.meaning1: taste of the Dhamma; flavour of the Dhamma

examples.text: sabbadānaṃ dhammadānaṃ jināti, sabbarasaṃ dhammaraso jināti, sabbaratiṃ dhammarati jināti, taṇhakkhayo sabbadukkhaṃ jināti.

34842.meaning1: passion for the teaching; love for the Dhamma

examples.text: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti, ten'eva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.

34843.meaning1: greed for mental phenomena; desire for thoughts

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, upavāṇa, bhikkhu manasā dhammaṃ viññāya dhammappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammarāgappaṭisaṃvedī ca.

34844.meaning1: experiencing greed for mental phenomena; experiencing desire for thoughts
34844.meaning2: experiencing greed for the mental phenomena; experiencing desire for the thoughts

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, upavāṇa, bhikkhu manasā dhammaṃ viññāya dhammappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammarāgappaṭisaṃvedī ca.

34845.meaning1: just king; righteous ruler; benign dictator
34845.commentary: (ANa) dhammarājā'ti tass'eva vevacanaṃ. dhammena vā laddharajjattā dhammarājā.

examples.text: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato. tass'imāni satta ratanāni bhavanti

khat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. upahat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā pitaraṃ dhammikaṃ dhammarājānaṃ jīvitā na voropessatha, imasmiññ'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ uppajjissathā'ti.

34846.meaning1: king of the Dhamma; epithet of the Buddha
34846.commentary: (MNa) ahañ'hi dhammarājā anuttaro bhav'aggato avīcipariyantaṃ katvā tiriyaṃ appamāṇalokadhātuyo anusāsāmi. yāvatā hi apadadvipad'ādi-bhedā sattā, ahaṃ tesaṃ aggo. na hi me koci sīlena vā… vimuttiñāṇadassanena vā paṭibhāgo atthi, sv'āhaṃ evaṃ dhammarājā anuttaro anuttaren'eva catusatipaṭṭhān'ādi-bhedana dhammena cakkaṃ vattemi.

examples.text: idañ'hi taṃ jetavanaṃ, isisaṅghanisevitaṃ, āvutthaṃ dhammarājena, pītisañjananaṃ mama.
rāj'āham'asmi selā'ti, dhammarājā anuttaro, dhammena cakkaṃ vattemi, cakkaṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ.

34848.meaning1: justly acquired; honestly gained; legally obtained; legitimately acquired
34848.commentary: (SNa) dhammaladdhassā'ti dhammena samena laddhassa bhogassa dhammaladdhassa ca puggalassa.

examples.text: yo dhammaladdhassa dadāti dānaṃ, uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatassa jantu, atikkamma so vetaraṇiṃ yamassa, dibbāni ṭhānāni upeti macco'ti.

kodhanassa, bhikkhave, purisapuggalassa kodh'ābhibhūtassa kodhaparetassa, ye'pi'ssa te honti bhogā uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sed'āvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā, te'pi rājāno rājakosaṃ pavesenti kodh'ābhibhūtassa.

dhammasamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammacchando, dhammacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariḷāho, dhammapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariyesanā, dhammapariyesanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammalābho.

34850.meaning1: thought about mental phenomena; conception of thoughts

examples.text: dhammadhātuṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaññā, dhammasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaṅkappo, dhammasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammacchando, dhammacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariḷāho, dhammapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariyesanā.

34851.meaning1: Book 1 of the Abhidhamma; Enumeration of Phenomena

examples.text: āyasmā ca nāgaseno kusalā dhammā, akusalā dhammā, abyākatā dhammā'ti tikadukapaṭimaṇḍitaṃ dhammasaṅgaṇīpakaraṇaṃ, khandhavibhaṅg'ādi aṭṭhārasa vibhaṅgapaṭimaṇḍitaṃ vibhaṅgappakaraṇaṃ

34852.commentary: (ANa) aṭṭhame catūhi paccayehi saṅgaho āmisasaṅgaho, dhammena saṅgaho dhammasaṅgaho

examples.text: katame dve? āmisasaṅgaho ca dhammasaṅgaho ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve saṅgahā.

tato therā ime amhesu garucittīkāraṃ na karontī'ti navake bhikkhū dvīhi saṅgahehi na saṅgaṇhanti, n'eva dhammasaṅgahena saṅgaṇhanti, na āmisasaṅgahena, cīvarena vā pattena vā pattapariyāpannena vā vasanaṭṭhānena vā kilamante'pi nappaṭijagganti, pāḷiṃ vā aṭṭhakathaṃ vā dhammakathābandhaṃ vā guḷhaganthaṃ vā na sikkhāpenti.

bhagavatā cha cīvarāni anuññātāni. dhammasaṅgāhakattherehi tesaṃ anulomāni dukūlaṃ, pattuṇṇaṃ, cīnapaṭṭaṃ, somārapaṭṭaṃ, iddhimayikaṃ, devadattiyan'ti aparāni cha anuññātāni. tattha pattuṇṇanti pattuṇṇadese pāṇakehi sañjātavatthaṃ.

34854.meaning2: communal recitation of the teaching; Buddhist council

34855.meaning1: thoughts about mental phenomena; intention regarding thoughts

examples.text: katame ca, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, cetanākāyā, rūpasañcetanā, saddasañcetanā, gandhasañcetanā, rasasañcetanā, phoṭṭhabbasañcetanā, dhammasañcetanā.

34856.meaning1: recognition of mental activity; perception of mental phenomena

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave… se āyatane veditabbe yattha mano ca nirujjhati, dhammasaññā ca nirujjhati, se āyatane veditabbe'ti. idaṃ vatvā bhagavā uṭṭhāy'āsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cha'y'imā, bhikkhave, saññā, rūpasaññā, saddasaññā, gandhasaññā, rasasaññā, phoṭṭhabbasaññā, dhammasaññā.
dve'me, bhikkhave, bālā. katame dve? yo ca adhamme dhammasaññī, yo ca dhamme adhammasaññī. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve bālā'ti.

34859.commentary: (ANa) catūhi paccayehi attano ca parassa ca antarapaṭicchādanavasena santharaṇaṃ āmisasanthāro, dhammena santharaṇaṃ dhammasanthāro.

examples.text: katame dve? āmisasanthāro ca dhammasanthāro ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve santhārā.

34860.meaning1: corruption of the teaching; pollution of the doctrine
34860.commentary: (ANa) dhammasandosā vinayasandoso'ti dhammasandosena vinayasandoso hoti. kathaṃ pana dhammasmiṃ dussante vinayo dussati nāma? samathavipassanādhammesu gabbhaṃ aggaṇhantesu pañcavidho vinayo na hoti, evaṃ dhamme dussante vinayo dussati. dussīlassa pana saṃvaravinayo nāma na hoti, tasmiṃ asati samathavipassanā gabbhaṃ na gaṇhāti. evaṃ vinayasandosen'api dhammasandoso veditabbo.

examples.text: te'pi bhavissanti abhāvitakāyā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā. iti kho, bhikkhave, dhammasandosā vinayasandoso, vinayasandosā dhammasandoso. idaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ eta'r'ahi asamuppannaṃ āyatiṃ samuppajjissati.

34861.commentary: (ANa) āmisassa cinanaṃ vaḍḍhanaṃ āmisasannicayo, dhammassa cinanaṃ vaḍḍhanaṃ dhammasannicayo.

examples.text: katame dve? āmisasannicayo ca dhammasannicayo ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve sannicayā.
sutt'antaṃ abhidhammañ'ca, vinayañ'cā'pi kevalaṃ, nav'aṅgaṃ buddhavacanaṃ, esā dhammasabhā tava.
sa puṇṇako kurūnaṃ kattuseṭṭhaṃ, oropiya dhammasabhāya majjhe, ājaññam'āruyha anomavaṇṇo, pakkāmi vehāyasam'antalikkhe.

34864.meaning1: investigation of the character; examination of the qualities (of)

examples.text: evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tathāgate dhammasamannesanā hoti. evañ'ca pana tathāgato dhammatāsusamanniṭṭho hotī'ti.

34865.commentary: (SNa) āgat'amha imaṃ dhammasamayan'ti evaṃ samāgate devakāye disvā mayam'pi imaṃ dhammasamūhaṃ āgatā.

examples.text: mahāsamayo pavanasmiṃ, devakāyā samāgatā, āgat'amha imaṃ dhammasamayaṃ, dakkhitāye aparājitasaṅghan'ti.

34866.meaning1: undertaking a practice; taking up something

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhaṃ āyatiṃ dukkhavipākaṃ, atthi, bhikkhave, dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannadukkhañ'c'eva āyatiñ'ca dukkhavipākaṃ

34867.meaning1: meditative composure based on natural principles
34867.commentary: (SNa) ettha dhammasamādhī'ti dasa-kusalakammapatha-dhammā, cittasamādhī'ti saha vipassanāya cattāro maggā. atha vā pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyatī'ti (a. ni. 5.26) evaṃ vuttā pāmojja-pīti-passaddhi-sukha-samādhi-saṅkhātā pañca dhammā dhammasamādhi nāma, cittasamādhi pana saha vipassanāya cattāro maggā'va. atha vā dasakusalakammapathā cattāro brahmavihārā cā'ti ayaṃ dhammasamādhi nāma, taṃ dhammasamādhiṃ pūrentassa uppannā citt'ek'aggatā cittasamādhi nāma.
34867.notes: The commentary seems unusually uncertain about the specific meanings of dhammasamādhi and cittasamādhi.

examples.text: sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. ayaṃ kho, gāmaṇi, dhammasamādhi. tatra ce tvaṃ cittasamādhiṃ paṭilabheyyāsi, evaṃ tvaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pajaheyyāsi.

34868.meaning1: arising of phenomena; origination of causes

examples.text: suddhaṃ dhammasamuppādaṃ, suddhaṃ saṅkhārasantatiṃ, passantassa yathābhūtaṃ, na bhayaṃ hoti gāmaṇi.

34869.meaning1: contact with mental phenomena; impression of thoughts; phenomenological experience

examples.text: dhammadhātuṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaññā, dhammasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaṅkappo, dhammasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasamphasso, dhammasamphassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasamphassajā vedanā

34870.meaning1: produced by contact with mental phenomena; caused by the impression of thoughts; born from phenomenal experience

examples.text: dhammadhātuṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaññā, dhammasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaṅkappo, dhammasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasamphasso, dhammasamphassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasamphassajā vedanā, dhammasamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammacchando, dhammacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariḷāho, dhammapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariyesanā, dhammapariyesanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammalābho.

34871.meaning1: generated by mental phenomena; produced by thought

examples.text: tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā, anekā dhammasambhavā, abhijjhā ca vihesā ca, cittam'ass'ūpahaññati, evaṃ ācinato dukkhaṃ, ārā nibbānam'uccati.

34872.meaning1: partaking of the teaching together; mutual enjoyment of Dhamma
34872.commentary: (VIN 2.5.7.9) dhammasambhogo nāma uddisati vā uddisāpeti vā, padena uddisati vā uddisāpeti vā, pade pade āpatti pācittiyassa. akkharāya uddisati vā uddisāpeti vā, akkhar'akkharāya āpatti pācittiyassa.

examples.text: sambhuñjeyya vā'ti sambhogo nāma dve sambhogā, āmisasambhogo ca dhammasambhogo ca.

34873.meaning1: considered to be moral; regarded as natural
34873.commentary: (DNa) tadeta'r'ahi dhammasammatan'ti taṃ idāni dhammo'ti sammataṃ, dhammo'ti taṃ gahetvā vicaranti.

examples.text: adhammasammataṃ kho pana, vāseṭṭha, tena samayena hoti, tadeta'r'ahi dhammasammataṃ. ye kho pana, vāseṭṭha, tena samayena sattā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevanti, te māsam'pi dvemāsam'pi na labhanti gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā pavisituṃ.

34874.meaning1: pleased with mental phenomena; enjoying thinking

examples.text: kāyo kho, māgaṇḍiya, phoṭṭhabb'ārāmo phoṭṭhabbarato… mano kho, māgaṇḍiya, dhamm'ārāmo dhammarato dhammasammudito. so tathāgatassa danto gutto rakkhito saṃvuto, tassa ca saṃvarāya dhammaṃ deseti.

34875.meaning1: taking refuge in the Dhamma; relying on the Dhamma; finding support in the teaching
34875.meaning2: placing one's faith in the Dhamma

examples.text: tasmā't'ih'ānanda, attadīpā viharatha attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā, dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā
sādhu kho, devānam'inda, dhammasaraṇagamanaṃ hoti. dhammasaraṇagamanahetu kho, devānam'inda, evam'idh'ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.

34877.meaning1: because of taking refuge in the Dhamma

examples.text: sādhu kho, devānam'inda, dhammasaraṇagamanaṃ hoti. dhammasaraṇagamanahetu kho, devānam'inda, evam'idh'ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.

34878.meaning2: body of the Dhamma; essence of the teaching

34879.commentary: (THa) so tena puññakammena devaloke nibbattitvā apar'āparaṃ sugatīsu'y'eva saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde magadharaṭṭhe brāhmaṇakule nibbattitvā dhammasavo'ti laddhanāmo viññutaṃ patto hetusampattiyā codiyamāno ghar'āvāse ādīnavaṃ pabbajjāya ānisaṃsañ'ca disvā dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ viharantaṃ bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā dhammaṃ sutvā paṭiladdhasaddho pabbajitvā vipassanāya kammaṃ karonto nacirass'eva arahattaṃ pāpuṇi. tena vuttaṃ apadāne
34879.notes: Theragāthā verse 107 (TH1.107, TH107) is attributed to him.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā dhammasavo thero gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.
dve'me, bhikkhave, saṃvibhāgā āmisasaṃvibhāgo ca dhammasaṃvibhāgo ca. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ dvinnaṃ saṃvibhāgānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammasaṃvibhāgo.

34884.meaning1: connected with Dhamma; related to the teaching; connected with reality

examples.text: na h'etaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, atthasaṃhitaṃ na dhammasaṃhitaṃ n'ādibrahmacariyakaṃ, na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati

34885.meaning1: talking about the Dhamma; Dhamma discussion

examples.text: kālena dhammassavanaṃ, kālena dhammasākacchā, kālena sammasanā, kālena vipassanā
khantī ca sovacassatā, samaṇānañ'ca dassanaṃ, kālena dhammasākacchā, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

34886.meaning1: master of the Dhamma; lord of the teaching; epithet of the Buddha

34887.meaning1: essence of the Dhamma; the core of the teaching

examples.text: ye etadaññāya padaṃ asaṅkhataṃ, vimuttacittā bhavanettisaṅkhayā, te dhammasār'ādhigamā khaye ratā, pahaṃsu te sabbabhavāni tādino'ti.

34888.meaning1: realizing the essence of the Dhamma; reaching the core of the teaching
34888.commentary: (ITIa) dhammasār'ādhigamā'ti vimuttisārattā imassa dhammavinayassa, dhammesu sārabhūtassa arahattassa adhigamanato.

examples.text: ye etadaññāya padaṃ asaṅkhataṃ, vimuttacittā bhavanettisaṅkhayā, te dhammasār'ādhigamā khaye ratā, pahaṃsu te sabbabhavāni tādino'ti.

34889.meaning1: following the Dhamma; conforming to the teaching; (or) remembering the Dhamma
34889.commentary: (SNa) tam'ahaṃ naraṃ dhammasārī'ti brūmī'ti yo evaṃ paṭipajjati, tam'ahaṃ puggalaṃ dhammasārī eso dhammasāriyā paṭicchanno'ti ca kusaladhammehi akusaladhamme sāretvā ṭhito'ti vā'ti vadāmī'ti.

examples.text: saccaṃ dhammo saṃyamo brahmacariyaṃ, majjhe sitā brāhmaṇa brahmapatti, sa t'ujjubhūtesu namo karohi, tam'ahaṃ naraṃ dhammasārī'ti brūmī'ti.

34893.meaning1: excellence of the teaching; superb nature of the Dhamma

examples.text: tato cittaṃ vimucci me, passa dhammasudhammataṃ, tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan'ti.

34894.meaning2: generalissimo of the Law, epithet of Sāriputta

34895.meaning1: Dhamma general; epithet of the Buddha
34895.meaning2: generalissimo of the Dhamma, epithet of the Buddha

examples.text: evaṃ dhammasenāpatinā ca pasatthabhāv'ānurūpaṃ attano dhāraṇabalaṃ dassento sattānaṃ sotu'kamyataṃ janeti evaṃ me sutaṃ, tañ'ca kho atthato vā byañjanato vā anūnaman'adhikaṃ, evam'eva na aññathā daṭṭhabban'ti.
ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma, ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno sīl'ānussatiṃ bhāveti.

34898.meaning1: hearing the teaching; hearing a sermon; listening to the Dhamma

examples.text: pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ānisaṃsā dhammassavane. katame pañca? assutaṃ suṇāti, sutaṃ pariyodāpeti, kaṅkhaṃ vitarati, diṭṭhiṃ ujuṃ karoti, cittam'assa pasīdati.
ekasmiñ'hi kāle satthari āḷavinagaraṃ upanissāya agg'āḷave cetiye viharante bahū upāsakā upāsikā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ca vihāraṃ dhammassavan'atthāya gacchanti, divā dhammassavanaṃ hoti.

34899.meaning1: hall where the Dhamma is preached; hall for listening to sermons
34899.commentary: (PYt) dhammassavan'aggan'ti dhammassavanaṃ gaṇhanti etthā'ti dhammassavan'aggo, dhammasavanamaṇḍapo. atha vā dhammassavanaṃ gaṇhātī'ti dhammassavan'aggo, dhammassavanaṭṭhāne samāgamajano, taṃ dhammassavan'aggaṃ.

examples.text: dhammassavan'agge pana nisīditvā niddāyanto c'eva nānappakārañ'ca niratthakakathaṃ kathento dhamme agāravo viharati nāma. saṅghamajjhe bāhāvikkhepakaṃ nānattakathaṃ kathento theranavamajjhimesu ca cittīkāraṃ akaronto saṅghe agāravo viharati nāma.
